title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: As of a half hour ago, Mize was getting a MRI. In Omaha covering Michigan but any kind of heads up on results would be appreciated. Will go through proper channels before putting it out.
Don’t have the official read right now.  Just preliminary.
And when do you get official read
The unofficial won’t be made public but it’s good news.  The official will come whenever our guy gets a chance to read it

Ok, thanks for getting back to me. Would it be accurate to say something like “The Tigers were optimistic last night that Casey Mize was not seriously injured and are even more so after receiving the results of his MRI scan today.”
Until I get the official results I wouldn’t be comfortable with you saying that cause we just don’t know yet.
Crunk is working on the official language for the statement on Mize.  Your statement in your text is accurate.
